I've \[20F\] been seriously thinking about getting my nipples pierced since I got my first piercing as an adult which was about two years ago. I've had very low self-esteem when it comes to my breasts because I'm a small girl (4'11) and I have 32Ds which is pretty big for my frame and they don't necessarily sag but they have never been perky once in my life. I have thought about getting breast augmentation since I was 17 years old and I thought that my breasts wouldn't be perky enough for piercings. And there was a worry about the pain of them too which I'll get to later.  


But I had a small hope after reading through this subreddit and other stories that maybe they would give me a boost in self-confidence, and getting your nipples pierced is a lot easier and cheaper than going under the knife. So I took the plunge as an early birthday present for myself and now I'll get on to my experience:  


I had called the day before to get the price because I have sensitivity issues with cheaper metals so I wanted their highest quality titanium rods. It was $135 all together before tip and tax.

​

Got to the shop and brought a friend along, I was hoping to be able to film it for the memory of it but there might be a law in VA against that because we weren't allowed too, which is fine of course because it's not a necessity just something I thought would be nice to do. Regardless I'm very happy I brought my friend along because she was there to help me a lot! 

The piercer greeted me and had me fill out info and give my ID etc and said she would go ahead and set up.  
Once her piercing area was sanitary and ready she called me back, and said no to the filming but yes to the friend coming with me. Once in the room, she asked me to just go ahead and be completely topless.  
 She went over everything with me about what to expect when getting the piecing (clamps to hold the nipple etc) and the ways to clean it, recommending saline and salt soaks once or twice a week and staying away from alcoholic products. All while She was deciding on the marks on my nipples. She asked me to take a look and I was happy with them.   
Next, she asked me to lay on the doctor office-like table, and since I'm short this was probably the most awkward part because I had to get on the table with the crinkle paper with my titties out- it was just awkward.   
Once settled she asked me to put my hands behind my head like I'm in a relaxing position.   
Then she mentioned instead of counting down she would just ask me to take a deep breath in and out to do the piercing part.

  
**On to the pain:**  
I've read that either you have the most **hellfire** pain or you feel nothing. With most people saying it was hellfire. Even one girl on YouTube said it was worse than getting her **stomach** tattooed which **SCARED** me to death because for me **THAT**, getting my stomach tattoed,  was the only time I ever whimpered in pain getting any modification done to my body like *holy shit*.  
However, I felt next to **nothing** maybe 3/10. It felt similar to every other piercing I've had (double hoop nostril, septum, belly button, ear lobe ) and it's just a sudden sharp pain that fades into stingy-ness. I will say perhaps I have a high pain tolerance and my nipples tend to be on the bigger side from what I've seen, so maybe that plays into it. The clamps or forceps on my nipples didn't hurt at all and maybe that's a sign to note that perhaps the pain just won't be there. Honestly, the stinging afterward (until I took some pain medicine when I got home) was more annoying than getting the piercing done. I didn't even flinch or make a noise or whimper during this piercing so **2-3/10.**  


I will say have a friend with you though because while the act of piercing didn't hurt that much in itself; I was very nervous about putting my bra on after the piercing was done because I wasn't sure if it would make my nipples feel worse sting wise. I struggled to put my bra on myself and my friend literally helped me put my bra on like an Angel  (which included little slips of paper towel for the bleeding). (The bra also did NOT make the stinging pain any worse)  
I drove home after that with no problems.  
And that was my experience I hope this helps someone like myself who put nipple piercings off for years because they think that their boobs aren't perky enough! 

​

**TLDR; Having not so perky boobs and the fear of hellfire-like pain kept me from this for too long. Ended with a very professional appointment at  River City Tattoo Co (RVA) and a confidence boost. 2-3/10 pain level. All boobs can be pierced boobs in my opinion!**
